note: THE PIN for every tree-sitter grammar wasm vendored in this directory (Phase 180). Each file is a prebuilt release asset from the named upstream, committed whole so the build downloads nothing. Bump version + url + sha256 + bytes together, never one of them, and verify with `shasum -a 256`. The seven other grammars are NOT here: they ship inside the @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm npm package (pinned exact in package.json) and electron-builder copies them from node_modules. src/main/symbols/paths.ts is the one module that knows which grammar lives where.
